comparison_policy: Forks are a time-stamped adoption signal only. Correctness, licensing, provenance, resource fit, and overlap ownership are reviewed independently; no upstream repository was copied or executed.

components.implementation: stdlib text/LaTeX parser, pypdf native-text parser, and normalized project-local external-parser adapter

upstreams.name: Docling
upstreams.architecture: multi-format document conversion with layout, table, formula, OCR, and structured JSON
upstreams.decision: admit normalized adapter contract; do not bundle models

upstreams.name: MinerU
upstreams.license: MinerU Open Source License: Apache-2.0 plus commercial-threshold and online-service attribution conditions
upstreams.decision: comparison and normalized user-supplied output only; custom terms and transitive model licenses require a separate review before installation or distribution

upstreams.name: Marker
upstreams.decision: admit normalized adapter; no models in core

upstreams.name: GROBID
upstreams.decision: admit normalized service-output adapter

components.implementation: append-only typed claims, source-hashed evidence, exact locators, support/refute/insufficient edges, and explicit conflict review

upstreams.name: PaperQA2
upstreams.decision: retain as optional retrieval backend; do not outsource verdicts

upstreams.name: SciFact
upstreams.license: no machine-readable repository license at snapshot
upstreams.architecture: claim verification corpus with evidence rationales
upstreams.decision: borrow relation vocabulary only; no dataset redistribution

upstreams.name: MultiVerS
upstreams.architecture: scientific claim verification with evidence selection
upstreams.decision: compare semantics; compact local graph remains owner

components.implementation: domain-routed publications plus patents, trials, grants, datasets, software, and preregistrations with per-source evidence and family coverage

upstreams.name: PyAlex
upstreams.decision: compare API ergonomics; keep stdlib adapters

upstreams.name: habanero
upstreams.decision: compare normalization; keep canonical evidence recorder

upstreams.name: scholarly

upstreams.name: DVC

upstreams.name: SciPy

upstreams.name: statsmodels
